segments.narration: The CIA surgically installed a microphone inside a live cat. Not a prop. A working animal, in the field.
This was the Directorate of Science and Technology, hunting a listening device that could walk past a Soviet guard.
One hour of surgery. A microphone in the ear canal, a transmitter at the base of the skull, an antenna threaded through the fur.
Twenty million dollars, by one officer's account. Then they let it go near the Soviet embassy in Washington and waited.
The files came out in 2001 saying a taxi ended it. A former technical director insists they removed the kit and the cat lived.
